title: Example Island

experience.tagline: Take the boat out, work the reef and deep water, and sell your catch to Joe before dark.
experience.loadingNote: The first launch compiles shaders and can take a minute or two. Later visits load much faster.
tips: Press R to equip the rod. Hold the left mouse button to wind up, then release to cast.
Watch the bobber. When it is pulled under, click to set the hook.
During a fight, keep line tension in the green. Ease off when the fish runs.
Fish vary by location and time of day: try the shallows, reef, and deep water beyond the drop-off.
Joe at the pier fish stand buys your catch. Marta at the boathouse sells fishing and boat upgrades.
Press E at the boat to board, at the wheel to take the helm, and again to step away.
Press I to open your cooler and fish log. Deck lights let you fish after dark.

styleGuide: Procedural volcanic island terrain. Preserve the coast, central bay, volcanic ridge, beaches, seabed, and terrain color regions.
